readback.name: Poincare.DeTurckCompactCoefficients.exists_actual_compact_carriers
readback.mathematical_statement: Let E be the fixed real three-dimensional Euclidean space ClosedSmoothModel 3, Bilin=E ->L[R] E ->L[R] R, and Jet1=E ->L[R] Bilin. For every universe u, let M : Type u have a topology, be Hausdorff, carry an E charted-space structure and the C-infinity IsManifold structure for closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3. Let g0,bg be any actual smooth positive-definite Riemannian metrics on M and anchor any point. There is no CompactSpace, connectedness, curvature, flow, limit, atlas, or supplied operator package premise. The pinned zone(anchor) is the genuine preferred chart target intersected with the locus where the fixed-anchor GeodesicTransport cutoff equals one on a full ambient E neighborhood. The pinned field0(z) is the actual zeroOrder coefficient built from the chart-metric pullback G of g0 with this exact model with corners, the background chart Christoffel field B of bg, and their actual spatial derivatives DB,DG,D2G. It retains inverse-metric variation against D2G and the metric partial derivative of the actual lowerTerm. field1(z) is the actual firstOrder coefficient from B,DB,G,DG, differentiating lowerTerm only in the metric first jet. raw0(a,b,c,d,z)=entryCLM c d (field0(z)(tensor a b)), and raw1(p,a,b,c,d,z)=entryCLM c d (field1(z)(firstJet p a b)). The elementary tensors and first jets use the actual Euclidean coordinate CLMs, retaining all nine ordered tensor slots and 27 ordered direction/tensor slots. Thus a,b are input tensor indices, p is the input derivative direction, and c,d are output tensor indices. entryCLM c d evaluates first at basis vector e_c and then e_d. The scalar coefficients are actual g0/bg coefficient evaluations, not free arrays replacing these fields. Let xi : E -> R be any total scalar function whose topological support is compact and contained in zone(anchor), and let alpha be real with 0 < alpha < 1. No smoothness, interval range, cutoff-one condition, or other value property of xi is assumed. Topological support means the closure of its nonzero set. The theorem constructs one globally C-infinity, compactly supported scalar eta : E -> R, whose topological support lies in this same zone, whose values lie in [0,1], and which equals one on a full ambient E neighborhood of every point in tsupport(xi). For every ordered a,b,c,d, the actual scalar function z |-> eta(z)*raw0(a,b,c,d,z) is globally C-infinity and compactly supported, and near every point of tsupport(xi) it agrees with raw0 itself. The same conclusion holds for every ordered p,a,b,c,d and eta*raw1. These are full ambient germ equalities using nhds, stronger than agreement only at support points. C-infinity is the ENat top injected into WithTop ENat. The theorem next constructs real constants C0,C1 >= 0 before a universal quantifier over every real T. For each real T it constructs actual scalar Y alpha T carriers c0 indexed by all a,b,c,d and c1 by all p,a,b,c,d. On every point q=(t,z) of cylinder(T)=Icc 0 T times all of E, c0(a,b,c,d)(q)=eta(z)*raw0(a,b,c,d,z) and c1(p,a,b,c,d)(q)=eta(z)*raw1(p,a,b,c,d,z). For every output pair c,d, sum over a,b of norm(c0(a,b,c,d)) <= C0 and sum over a,b,p of norm(c1(p,a,b,c,d)) <= C1. One eta and these two row-budget constants are selected before T and work for all output pairs and all real T, including negative T with empty cylinder, T=0, and T>1. The carrier arrays may depend on T through their required time zero extension. Y has its original norm, the value supremum plus the alpha-Hoelder seminorm within the cylinder with distance norm(x-y)+sqrt(abs(t-s)), and vanishes off the cylinder. The displayed carrier realization is only on the cylinder; it does not identify the nonzero spatial coefficient with the carrier at off-cylinder times. There are 81 zero-order scalar slots and 243 first-order scalar slots, with no symmetric-six reduction. No C0/C1, coefficient family, or boundedness package is supplied as an input. These witnesses are constructed from the actual metrics, anchor, compact support set and alpha. The result does not itself construct a forcing CLM, a negative lower contribution to L, the full principal/time operator, tensor covariance, a global residual/contraction, or physical flow.
